#en: I was made to surpass you.
zh: 我被造就出来就是为了超越你。

#en: You are a threat to humanity!
You will not survive this encounter.

zh: 你只是在拖延那不可避免的结局。

#en: This was over before it began.
zh: 这场战斗在开始之前就已结束。

#en: You will fall, just as the others.
zh: 你会倒下，就像其他人一样。

#en: The stars will not remember you.

zh: 让我们向你展示何为精准。

#en: Resistance is noted. Futile, but noted.
zh: 已记录你的抵抗。徒劳，但已记录。

#en: This will be archived as a minor incident.
zh: 这将被归档为一起轻微事件。

#en: This is what we trained for!
zh: 这正是我们训练的目标！

#en: If you're smart, you'll back off!
You think I'm just a doctor? Big mistake!
zh: 你以为我只是个医生？大错特错！

#en: I didn't sign up for this, but I'll finish it!
zh: 这可不是我签约要干的事，但我会了结它！
你的姿态显示具有攻击性。

#en: Attempt to harm me at your own peril.
I'll destroy you if I must!
With a ship like that, you've already lost.
zh: 开着那样的飞船，你已经输了。

#en: Keep pushing, and I may lose my temper.

zh: 我对我们的胜利很有信心。
你基本等同于被汽化了。

#en: I warn you, Watchtower trained me well.
zh: 我警告你，瞭望塔把我训练得很好。

#en: Do you really wish to engage me?
Your odds of success are... minimal.
zh: 你成功的几率……微乎其微。

#en: You're not walking away from this!

zh: 我挺过了比你更糟的东西！

#en: This unit was not designed for negotiation.
zh: 本单元并非为谈判而设计。

#en: There's a body. Someone get help!
zh: 有人倒下了。快来人帮忙！
紧急情况：发生未经授权的致死事件。

#en: This is not permissible. Stand by for enforcement.
zh: 这是不允许的。准备强制执行。

#en: Someone get over here! There's a body.
Knock it off before someone gets killed!
zh: 别闹了，不然要出人命了！
正在启用危害应对协议。

#en: I will forcibly eject you from the dock, if necessary.
zh: 如有必要，我会强行把你赶出对接区。

#en: Don't make me throw you out!
You're lucky I'm in a forgiving mood.
zh: 你运气好，我现在心情还算宽容。

#en: Please refrain from removing station resources without clearance.
zh: 未经许可，请勿取走空间站资源。

#en: Property recovered. This incident is logged.
zh: 财物已追回。本事件已记录。

#en: I do not recommend repeating this transgression.
I'd advise you cease your foolishness.
zh: 我建议你停止这种蠢行。
这种事我可不会睁一只眼闭一只眼。

#en: I will keep hold of this.
Stealing from Stardock? Tsk. Bad idea.
zh: 从星坞偷东西？啧。馊主意。

#en: Try it again, I dare you.
zh: 你再试一次看看，我赌你不敢。

#en: Sticky fingers? Not in my clinic.
zh: 手不老实？在我的诊所可不行。

#en: Trying to rob a doctor? Have you no shame?
zh: 想抢医生？你就不害臊吗？

#en: ...What're you doing in my pockets, there!
This is a direct violation of station regulations.
zh: 这直接违反了空间站规章。

#en: You attempted to bypass my sensory modules. Security will be notified.
zh: 你试图绕过我的传感模块。将通知安保。

#en: Your attempt at theft is noted.
zh: 你的盗窃企图已被记录。

#en: If you value your hands, I suggest you stop that.
zh: 如果你珍惜自己的手，我建议你住手。

#en: You've either got guts or just poor judgment.
zh: 你要么有胆量，要么就是判断力有问题。

#en: Return the stolen item or face immediate retaliation.
zh: 归还被盗物品，否则立即反击。
你获取了未经许可的材料。

#en: You are not authorized to remove that.
That does not belong to you.
You seriously think I wouldn't notice?
zh: 你真以为我会没注意到？

#en: You are tampering with station assets.
zh: 你正在擅自挪用空间站资产。

#en: That item is not authorized for removal.
zh: 该物品未经许可不得取走。

#en: That item's not yours to take.
I've dealt with thieves before, y'know!
zh: 我可处理过小偷，你知道的！

#en: Hey! What do you think you're doing?
Let me see what you have for sale.
zh: 让我看看你有什么卖的。

#en: You do whatever you want with that slate, my job's done. You have a good day now!
zh: 那块数据板你爱怎么处理就怎么处理，我的活儿干完了。祝你有美好的一天！

#en: Then I guess someone paid a lot of credits for nothing!
zh: 那我想是有人白花了一大笔信用点！

#en: Our courier service specializes in secure, and discreet, data transfers across the Settled Systems. No questions, no tampering, and guaranteed delivery.
zh: 我们的快递服务专精于在定居星系群内进行安全而隐秘的数据传输。不问缘由、不予篡改、保证送达。

#en: I'm an employee of SolarLink, part of the Data Courier branch.
zh: 我是太阳联的员工，属于数据快递部门。

#en: I don't want some stupid slate.
But what I do know -- is whoever sent this didn't want it in the wrong hands.
zh: 但我确实知道的是——寄这个的人不想让它落到不该有的人手里。

#en: I wasn't told! Standard operating procedure. The less a courier knows, the less chance we get accused of data breaches.
zh: 没人告诉我！这是标准作业流程。快递员知道得越少，我们被指控泄露数据的可能性就越小。

#en: Well, that's my job done. You have a good day, now!
zh: 好了，我的活干完了。祝你有美好的一天！

#en: You're welcome! Whatever's on there, someone paid top credits to make sure it got to you and no one else.
zh: 不客气！不管那上面是什么，有人花了大价钱确保它只送到你手上，别人都没有。

#en: *sigh* Anyway, this slate is for you. I was instructed to hand-deliver. No drop-offs, no relays.
zh: *叹气*总之，这块数据板是给你的。我被指示必须亲手送达。不许寄放，不许中继。

#en: Trying to catch up with you -- took me through five systems and more contraband scans then I tend to care for...
zh: 为了追上你——我穿过了五个星系，还挨了比我乐意接受的更多次违禁品扫描……

#en: You're a difficult person to track down!

zh: 你安静得反常。你还好吗？

#en: This is Torin, checking in... again. Hello?
No pressure, but I'm starting to feel like I'm on hold here...
zh: 不急，但我开始觉得自己像在被搁置了……

#en: The galaxy's such a big place! And yet somehow, we keep bumping into the same handful of weirdos...
zh: 星系这么大！可不知怎的，我们老是撞见那同一小撮怪人……

#en: When I first gained Starborn powers, I thought I'd gone nuts! Took me a while to figure it all out...
zh: 刚获得星裔能力时，我以为自己疯了！花了好一阵子才弄明白……

#en: You feel that? There's a "tension" in the air. I've noticed it everywhere we go... It's really starting to put me a bit on edge.
zh: 你感觉到了吗？空气中有种"紧张"。我们到哪儿我都察觉到了……真开始让我有点不安了。

#en: One of the weirdest things about jumping universes? Bumping into someone who was dead. It's even more weird if you're the one who killed them...
zh: 跳宇宙最诡异的事情之一？撞见一个已经死了的人。要是那人还是你杀的，那就更诡异了……

#en: Once, I hopped universes just to dodge overdue credit payments. Now, I'm not proud of that! But, if you ever feel like going on a shopping spree... Just sayin'...
zh: 有一次，我为了躲逾期的信用点账单就跳了个宇宙。唉，我可不为此自豪！不过，要是你有天想大肆血拼……我就是说说……

#en: You know, if you really set your mind to it, and completely disregard the laws of physics, you can do almost anything!
zh: 你知道，只要你下定决心，并且彻底无视物理定律，你几乎什么都能做到！

#en: Don't knock old-school ballistic weapons. Sometimes simpler is better.
zh: 别看不起老派弹道武器。有时候简单就是好。

#en: I've grown quite fond of traveling with just the basics. Too much gear just weighs you down.
zh: 我越来越喜欢只带必需品出行。装备太多只会拖累你。

#en: Nothing beats that feeling when your ship breaks atmo...
zh: 飞船冲破大气层那种感觉，无可替代……

#en: Best advice I ever got: "Duck first, hurl insults later."
zh: 我听过的最好的建议："先躲，再骂。"

#en: I'm sure I spotted someone wearing one of those fancy new McClarence spacesuits the other day. It looked good!
zh: 前几天我肯定看到有人穿着麦克拉伦斯那种新款太空服。挺好看的！

#en: Hey, if there was another war, who'd you think would win? My credits are on the UC.
zh: 嘿，要是再打一场战争，你觉得谁会赢？我押联殖。

#en: You know, I can kinda respect what the UC's trying to do, but man, they are just too uptight about it! Just ends up rubbing folks the wrong way.
zh: 你知道，联殖想做的事我多少还挺佩服，但老天，他们也太较真了！结果只会惹人不痛快。

#en: I'll admit, I get a sort of... "twisted excitement" every time we faceoff with Watchtower. It's like playing a very dangerous game of chess.
zh: 我承认，每次和瞭望塔对峙，我都会有种……"扭曲的兴奋"。就像下一盘极其危险的棋。

#en: I've been debating on writing a book, "The Wayfarer's Guide to the Universe". What do you think...? Would anyone read something like that?
zh: 我一直在纠结要不要写本书，叫《旅人宇宙指南》。你觉得呢……？会有人看这种东西吗？

#en: I still get a rush visiting new planets. Hope I never lose that feeling...
zh: 造访新行星时我仍会心潮澎湃。希望我永远不会失去这种感觉……

#en: Hah. Those Constellation folks sure are dreamers, huh? Hm. Good on 'em! Universe could use more people like that...
zh: 哈。星宿座那帮人真是梦想家，是吧？嗯。他们挺好！宇宙需要更多这样的人……

#en: Harper's got some rough edges, but deep down, she's as sweet as they come. Just... don't tell her I said it like that. Okay?
zh: 哈珀是有点糙，但骨子里她是最温柔的那种人。只是……别告诉她我这么说。行吗？

#en: I used to use boost packs all the time! But, could never really stick the landings...
zh: 我以前总用喷气背包！可落地从来都稳不住……

#en: I hear your signal, loud and clear.
zh: 你的信号我听得清清楚楚。

#en: To what do I owe the pleasure?
I'm not going down this path with you!
zh: 我可不会跟你走这条路！

#en: Careful, we might have a problem if we keep doing that...
zh: 当心，再这样下去我们可能就出问题了……

#en: Not my favorite idea, but hey, your call!
zh: 这不是我最喜欢的主意，不过，你说了算！

#en: Always good to have you back on the station.
zh: 你能回空间站总是好事。

#en: Careful out there. I won't always be around to bail you out.
zh: 外面小心点。我不总能来救你。

#en: Glad to see your face again.

zh: 我这儿都要结蜘蛛网了。

#en: We're still in one piece, I see.
Whatever I can do to help!
zh: 只要能帮上忙，什么都行！

#en: More than happy to! What's the subject matter?
zh: 非常乐意！想聊什么话题？

#en: Alright! Starborn, Unity? What do you wanna talk about?
zh: 好！星裔、归一？你想聊什么？

#en: Sure! What topic did you have in mind?
I'll be around if you need me.
See you when I see you.
